<?php

const MOD = 998244353;
const MAX = 500;

$finv = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);
$inv = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);

$fac[0] = 1;
$fac[1] = 1;
$finv[0] = 1;
$finv[1] = 1;
$inv[1] = 1;

for ($i = 2; $i <= MAX; $i++) {
    $fac[$i] = $fac[$i - 1] * $i % MOD;
    $inv[$i] = MOD - (int)(MOD / $i) * $inv[MOD % $i] % MOD;
    $finv[$i] = $finv[$i - 1] * $inv[$i] % MOD;
}

$pow = array_fill(0, 501, array_fill(0, 501, 0));
for ($i = 0; $i <= 500; $i++) {
    $pow[$i][0] = 1;
    for ($j = 0; $j < 500; $j++) {
        $pow[$i][$j + 1] = $pow[$i][$j] * $i % MOD;
    }
}

function comb($n, $k) {
    global $fac, $finv;
    if ($n < $k) return 0;
    return $fac[$n] * $finv[$k] % MOD * $finv[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

function min2($a, $b) {
    return $a < $b ? $a : $b;
}

$x = $data[1];

$dp = array_fill(0, 501, array_fill(0, 501, 0));

for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $jj = min2($x, $i - 1);
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $jj; $j++) {
        $dp[$i][$j] = ($pow[$j][$i] - $pow[$j - 1][$i]) % MOD;
        if ($dp[$i][$j] < 0) $dp[$i][$j] += MOD;
    }
}

for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $x; $j++) {
        if ($dp[$i][$j] == 0) continue;
        for ($k = 0; $k <= $n - $i; $k++) {
            $nj = $j + $i + $k - 1;
            if ($nj > $x) break;
            $add = $dp[$i][$j] * $pow[$i + $k - 1][$k] % MOD * comb($i + $k, $k) % MOD;
            $dp[$i + $k][$nj] = ($dp[$i + $k][$nj] + $add) % MOD;
        }
    }
}

$ans = 0;
for ($j = 1; $j <= $x; $j++) {
    $ans = ($ans + $dp[$n][$j]) % MOD;
}
$ans = (($ans % MOD) + MOD) % MOD;
echo $ans . "\n";

<?php
const MOD = 998244353;
const MAX = 500;

$fac = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);
$finv = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);
$inv = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);

function init() {
    global $fac, $finv, $inv;
    $fac[0] = 1;
    $fac[1] = 1;
    $finv[0] = 1;
    $finv[1] = 1;
    $inv[1] = 1;
    for ($i = 2; $i <= MAX; $i++) {
        $fac[$i] = $fac[$i - 1] * $i % MOD;
        $inv[$i] = MOD - (int)(MOD / $i) * $inv[MOD % $i] % MOD;
        $finv[$i] = $finv[$i - 1] * $inv[$i] % MOD;
    }
}

function comb($n, $k) {
    global $fac, $finv;
    if ($n < $k) return 0;
    return $fac[$n] * $finv[$k] % MOD * $finv[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

function min_val($a, $b) {
    return $a < $b ? $a : $b;
}

init();

$pow = array();
for ($i = 0; $i <= MAX; $i++) {
    $pow[$i] = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);
    $pow[$i][0] = 1;
    for ($j = 1; $j <= MAX; $j++) {
        $pow[$i][$j] = $pow[$i][$j - 1] * $i % MOD;
    }
}

$stdin = fopen("php://stdin", "r");
fscanf($stdin, "%d %d", $n, $x);

$dp = array();
for ($i = 0; $i <= MAX; $i++) {
    $dp[$i] = array_fill(0, MAX + 1, 0);
}

for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $jj = min_val($x, $i - 1);
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $jj; $j++) {
        $val = $pow[$j][$i] - $pow[$j - 1][$i];
        $val %= MOD;
        if ($val < 0) $val += MOD;
        $dp[$i][$j] = $val;
    }
}

for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $x; $j++) {
        if ($dp[$i][$j] == 0) continue;
        for ($k = 0; $k <= $n - $i; $k++) {
            $nj = $j + $i + $k - 1;
            if ($nj > $x) break;
            $add = $dp[$i][$j] * $pow[$i + $k - 1][$k] % MOD * comb($i + $k, $k) % MOD;
            $dp[$i + $k][$nj] = ($dp[$i + $k][$nj] + $add) % MOD;
        }
    }
}

$ans = 0;
for ($j = 1; $j <= $x; $j++) {
    $ans = ($ans + $dp[$n][$j]) % MOD;
}
$ans = ($ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
echo $ans . "\n";
?>

source_data.prob_desc_description: There are $$$n$$$ heroes fighting in the arena. Initially, the $$$i$$$-th hero has $$$a_i$$$ health points.The fight in the arena takes place in several rounds. At the beginning of each round, each alive hero deals $$$1$$$ damage to all other heroes. Hits of all heroes occur simultaneously. Heroes whose health is less than $$$1$$$ at the end of the round are considered killed.If exactly $$$1$$$ hero remains alive after a certain round, then he is declared the winner. Otherwise, there is no winner.Your task is to calculate the number of ways to choose the initial health points for each hero $$$a_i$$$, where $$$1 \le a_i \le x$$$, so that there is no winner of the fight. The number of ways can be very large, so print it modulo $$$998244353$$$. Two ways are considered different if at least one hero has a different amount of health. For example, $$$[1, 2, 1]$$$ and $$$[2, 1, 1]$$$ are different.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer — the number of ways to choose the initial health points for each hero $$$a_i$$$, where $$$1 \le a_i \le x$$$, so that there is no winner of the fight, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$x$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 500; 1 \le x \le 500$$$).
